name_reason: Follows data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=chapter); reflects data type (table) and per-element semantics (per-character Y position). 'ch14'/'14' is the chapter ID (valid 01-30 domain ID, not a Ghidra address residue) and matches the consistent house naming of all sibling chapter end-scene tables in chtab2.c. No address residue. Accurately describes the verified use (pos_y arg to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro).
purpose: Const lookup table of per-character Y tile coordinates for the chapter 14 (Ping Yuan battle / 平原的會戰) end-scene character placement.
logic_summary: fd2_chapter_14_end @ 0x238dc copies all 16 bytes onto its stack via a MOVSD x4 block copy (var_28) and passes the block as the pos_y (2nd) argument to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro(pos_x, pos_y, facing, 0, 0xF, ...). The helper indexes the block per char_idx, reading one byte per char (stride 1) and storing it into runtime_char.bPos_y for chars 0..0xF. Sits between the ch14 pos_x_table (@0x52153) and ch14 facing_table (@0x52173), which bound it at 16 bytes.
element_semantics: One unsigned byte per character (chars 0..0xF) giving that character's Y battle-tile coordinate for the chapter-14 end scene. Values 12..16 (0x0C..0x10), all within battle-tile range. Stride 1, no element scaling.
notes: Memory at 0x52163 (0f0f0f1010100f0f0c0d0e0e0c0d0e0e) byte-matches src initializer exactly. Only 2 xrefs, both from fd2_chapter_14_end @0x23904(DATA)/@0x23909(READ); no writers anywhere -> confirms const. Source comment (chtab2.c lines 54-66) was already precise/correct/ASCII -> comment kept verbatim, chtab2.c not edited. Ghidra data plate was null (blank) -> created a concise PLATE_COMMENT (src is source of truth) via run_script_inline cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT). No rename applied this stage (verdict=keep).
